# Wikidata {#sec-wikidata}

CPS items can be linked to Wikidata with the property *Wikidata item* (P24). This chapter lists those links and uses Wikidata to describe John Baldessari.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))

from baldessari import cps, wikidata, table
links = cps.wikidata_links()
```

## Links from the CPS Wikibase

**`{python} len(links)`** CPS items point to Wikidata.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-wikidata-links
#| tbl-cap: "CPS items linked to Wikidata."
shown = links[["qid", "label", "types", "wikidata"]]
shown.columns = ["CPS ID", "Label", "Types", "Wikidata"]
table(shown)
```

## John Baldessari on Wikidata

```{python}
#| label: tbl-wikidata-profile
#| tbl-cap: "Selected Wikidata statements about John Baldessari (Q683378)."
profile = wikidata.artist_profile()
rows = (
    profile.assign(
        value=lambda d: d["valueLabel"].where(
            ~d["pid"].isin(["P569", "P570"]), d["valueLabel"].str[:10]
        )
    )
    .groupby("propertyLabel", sort=False)["value"]
    .agg("; ".join)
    .reset_index()
)
rows.columns = ["Property", "Value"]
table(rows)
```

## Entities referenced by the CPS data

```{python}
#| label: tbl-wikidata-entities
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptions of Wikidata entities referenced from CPS."
ents = wikidata.entities(links["wikidata"].dropna().unique().tolist())
shown = ents[["qid", "label", "description"]]
shown.columns = ["Wikidata", "Label", "Description"]
table(shown)
```
